item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Twenty One Pilots - More Than We Ever Imagined
item.description:
Hi all,

On February 26th, a new twenty one pilots film titled "Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined" will premiere in movie theaters, with limited IMAX previews on February 25th. It would mean the world to me (and many other fans!) if we could preserve this film, as the band has a history of screening films in theaters without ever releasing them afterward (looking at you, Twenty One Pilots: Cinema Experience Extended Cut ).

I’m not sure whether the film will premiere worldwide, but I know it will be shown in both the US and Europe.

I don’t know exactly how cinema-only releases are ripped, but I’ve seen it done before (for example, Coldplay’s Music of the Spheres shows and Taylor Swift’s The Eras Tour). If anyone here has the tools or experience to preserve this film, I would be extremely grateful.

Here's some links with information:
Official film website
IMDB
AMC Theatres
Cinemark
IMAX Website
Pathé website (French theater chain with theaters in France, the Netherlands, Switzerland and Belgium)
Kinepolis website (Belgian/Dutch theater chain)

|-/
